name: Commercial Kitchen Grease Trap Cleaning Guide
secondary_keywords: commercial kitchen grease trap cleaning procedure
how to clean an indoor grease trap
search_intent: Food business operators and kitchen managers needing step-by-step cleaning procedures, maintenance frequency, and compliance logs for indoor and external grease traps to prevent blocked sewers, foul odours, and fines under the Water Industry Act 1991.

competitors.title: How to Clean a Grease Trap | WebstaurantStore
competitors.strengths: Good general overview of physical cleaning steps.
competitors.weaknesses: Lacks UK legal framework (Water Industry Act s.111), no duty of care waste transfer note guidance.

competitors.title: Grease Trap Cleaning & Maintenance Guide | Alpheco UK
competitors.strengths: UK focus, mentions commercial waste regulations.
competitors.weaknesses: Sales pitch for pumping services, no interactive digital log or free printable checklist.

competitors.title: Grease Trap Maintenance Tips | Good Sense Solutions
competitors.weaknesses: Thin content, primarily promotes chemical products, lacks operational SOP.

competitors.title: Grease Trap Maintenance Services | Aqua Mundus
competitors.weaknesses: Gated service brochure, no DIY in-house cleaning steps or free downloadable log.

competitors.title: Fats, Oils and Greases (FOG) Management | Southern Water
competitors.strengths: High authority water company guidance on sewer obstruction offences.
competitors.weaknesses: Broad policy leaflet, lacks detailed hands-on operational checklist for kitchen porters.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Basic overview articles and contractor booking pages.
